business_problem: Greentube needed to replace disconnected support tools and manual partner processes so it could onboard new markets faster, maintain uptime across hundreds of gaming sites, and meet risk and compliance obligations without slowing operations.
solution_summary: Greentube standardized service operations on ServiceNow by combining Customer Service Management for its B2B partner portal, Discovery and Service Mapping for infrastructure visibility, a Configuration Management Database for the common service model, IT Service Management for incident handling, and Third-party Risk Management for vendor compliance. Partner accounts, contacts, and requests were moved into a single portal where B2B customers can self-register and submit cases, replacing email-heavy manual workflows. In parallel, Discovery and Service Mapping captured the architecture of more than 300 websites and platforms so network operations and IT teams could analyze incidents in context and monitor dependencies through shared dashboards. The result is a single operational backbone that connects partner support, infrastructure monitoring, and supplier governance while improving traceability, uptime, and onboarding speed.

solution_components.name: Customer Service Management
solution_components.role: Runs the integrated B2B partner portal where partners register, manage contacts, and submit service requests.

solution_components.name: Discovery
solution_components.role: Collects infrastructure details across Greentube's websites and gaming platforms.

solution_components.name: Service Mapping
solution_components.role: Maps service dependencies so teams can understand how issues affect each platform.

solution_components.name: Configuration Management Database (CMDB)
solution_components.role: Stores configuration, lifecycle, and relationship data for the services Greentube operates.

solution_components.name: IT Service Management
solution_components.role: Coordinates incidents and internal IT requests from the service desk and self-service portal.

solution_components.name: Third-party Risk Management
solution_components.role: Centralizes vendor details and compliance questionnaires for supplier risk reviews.

solution_components.name: Mobile Agent
solution_components.role: Sends downtime notifications to directors so operational issues are visible immediately.

data_flow: Partners submit requests through Customer Service Management, while partner spreadsheets and NOC input populate the shared portal and service catalogs. Discovery and Service Mapping feed topology and configuration data into the CMDB for more than 300 sites, IT Service Management routes incidents against that context, and Mobile Agent pushes downtime alerts while Third-party Risk Management gathers vendor responses for compliance reviews.
business_outcome: Greentube improved partner satisfaction, shortened new-market onboarding, reduced manual operational work, and gave service, risk, and operations teams a shared platform for maintaining availability and compliance at scale.
architecture_clues: The implementation models more than 300 websites and platforms in ServiceNow.
Greentube defined a common services data model before optimizing partner and IT service catalogs.
Single-pane dashboards and mobile notifications are used to track availability and downtime events.
evidence_quotes: We set out to streamline and align processes on one tool—standardize on a platform of platforms.
With ServiceNow as a foundation, we defined a common services data model and configuration database based on insights from our process experts and Do IT Wise.
All details, including configuration information, changes, expirations, and retirements, are all stored in the ServiceNow Configuration Management Database (CMDB).
Thanks to ServiceNow, entry into new markets and new partners has been dramatically shortened.
We have faster workflows and greater visibility to incidents with ServiceNow, minimizing website downtime.
